name: port-request
description: A request to port a Pi extension to Go

name: port:requested
description: Received, not yet read by a maintainer

name: port:needs-info
description: Waiting for the requester or upstream

name: port:triaged
description: Accepted into the queue; a ports.json row exists or is coming

name: port:in-progress
description: A porter lane is working (ports.json porting)

name: port:declined
description: Not accepted, with a reason in a comment

name: port:blocked-license
description: License does not permit a port, or is unknown
